title: Family Group Standing on Street, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A black and white 1955 snapshot featuring a family group of four adults posing together on a residential street. A classic 1950s automobile is parked behind them, with Victorian-style houses featuring distinctive gables in the background. The photo is date-stamped AUG 55 along the top margin and features scalloped deckle edges typical of mid-century photo prints.
